찍다.m: to take (a photo); to stamp; to dip
찍다.x: Let's take a photo together here.
찍다.e: Press-down actions: 사진을 찍다 (take a photo), 소스에 찍다 (dip in sauce).

복사.x: Could I ask you to make copies of the meeting materials?

집들이.ex: 이번 주말에 새 집에서 집들이를 해요.
집들이.x: We're having a housewarming party at our new place this weekend.
집들이.e: 집 'house' + 들이다 'to bring in'; guests often bring toilet paper or laundry detergent.

줍다.forms: 주워요 · 주웠어요 · 주울 거예요 · 주우세요 (ㅂ irregular)
줍다.ex: 길에서 지갑을 주워서 경찰서에 갖다 줬어요.
줍다.x: I picked up a wallet on the street and took it to the police station.
줍다.t: Don't confuse 주워요 'pick up' with 줘요 'give'.

경험하다.ex: 이번 여행에서 한국 문화를 많이 경험했어요.
경험하다.x: I experienced a lot of Korean culture on this trip.
경험하다.e: Literally 'go through and test' something for yourself.

작가.ex: 그 작가의 새 소설이 아주 인기가 많아요.
작가.x: That writer's new novel is very popular.

안타깝다.ex: 그 선수가 경기 중에 다쳐서 정말 안타까워요.
안타깝다.x: It's really heartbreaking that the player got hurt during the game.

불가능하다.ex: 혼자서 이 일을 하루에 끝내는 것은 불가능해요.
불가능하다.x: It's impossible to finish this work in one day by yourself.
불가능하다.e: 불- = 'not', a prefix you'll reuse often: 불편, 불안, 불가능.
불가능하다.t: Before ㄷ or ㅈ this prefix becomes 부-, as in 부족 'lack' and 부당 'unfair'.

링거.x: I had a bad case of body aches, so I got an IV at the hospital.
링거.e: From 'Ringer's (solution)', named after Sydney Ringer; English just says 'IV.'

아리랑.x: Even the foreign tourists sang along to Arirang.
아리랑.e: Name of Korea's best-known folk song; there are many regional versions. Origin of the word is uncertain.

성가시다.ex: 광고 전화가 자꾸 와서 정말 성가셔요.
성가시다.x: Spam calls keep coming, and it's really annoying.

흐릿하다.ex: 안경을 안 써서 글씨가 흐릿하게 보여요.
흐릿하다.x: I'm not wearing my glasses, so the letters look blurry.
흐릿하다.e: Related to 흐리다 'cloudy, unclear'; -릿하다 adds a 'somewhat' feel.

중요도.x: I sorted my tasks in order of importance.

공사.ex: 아파트 앞에서 도로 공사를 하고 있어요.
공사.x: There's road construction going on in front of the apartment.
공사.t: Homonym warning: 공사 also means 'public corporation', as in 한국전력공사.

동호인.x: Every weekend I play tennis with other tennis enthusiasts.
동호인.e: Literally 'people who like the same thing.'

양가.ex: 결혼식 날짜는 양가 부모님과 상의해서 정했어요.
양가.x: We set the wedding date after talking it over with both sets of parents.

공유 자전거.ex: 출근할 때 공유 자전거를 타고 역까지 가요.
공유 자전거.x: When I go to work, I ride a shared bike to the station.
공유 자전거.t: You rent one through an app and return it at a docking station or designated spot; many cities run public bike-share systems.

권위적.ex: 요즘 젊은 세대는 권위적인 문화를 싫어해요.
권위적.x: Young people these days dislike authoritarian culture.
권위적.e: -적 turns a noun into a descriptor, like '-ic' or '-al': 권위적, 민주적.
권위적.t: 권위적 is negative (bossy, authoritarian), while 권위 있는 means respected and authoritative.

국채.ex: 정부는 부족한 예산을 채우려고 국채를 발행했습니다.
국채.x: The government issued bonds to cover the budget shortfall.

심리학.ex: 저는 대학에서 심리학을 전공하고 상담사가 됐어요.
심리학.x: I majored in psychology in college and became a counselor.

무의식.ex: 무의식 속에 숨은 기억이 꿈에 나타나기도 해요.
무의식.x: Memories hidden in the unconscious sometimes appear in dreams.

왕권.ex: 조선 초기에는 왕권을 강화하려는 노력이 많았어요.
왕권.x: In early Joseon, there were many efforts to strengthen royal power.
왕권.t: Pronounced [왕꿘] — the ㄱ in 권 is tensed.

낙오되다.m: to fall behind, to drop out, to be left behind
낙오되다.ex: 산행 중에 한 명이 일행에서 낙오됐어요.
낙오되다.x: One person fell behind the group during the hike.
낙오되다.e: Literally 'fall from the ranks' — dropping out of a marching line.

꼬리가 길면 밟힌다.forms: 꼬리가 길면 밟힌다고 · 꼬리가 길면 밟혀요
꼬리가 길면 밟힌다.m: if you keep doing wrong, you'll eventually get caught
꼬리가 길면 밟힌다.ex: 꼬리가 길면 밟힌다고, 결국 거짓말이 다 들통났어요.
꼬리가 길면 밟힌다.x: Keep it up long enough and you get caught; in the end all his lies came out.
꼬리가 길면 밟힌다.e: Literally 'a long tail gets stepped on.'
꼬리가 길면 밟힌다.t: Pronounced [발핀다] — ㅂ and ㅎ merge into ㅍ.

등을 떠밀다.forms: 등을 떠밀어요 · 등을 떠밀었어요 · 등 떠밀려서 (passive)
등을 떠밀다.m: to push someone into doing something; to pressure
등을 떠밀다.ex: 친구가 등을 떠밀어서 노래 대회에 나갔어요.
등을 떠밀다.x: My friend pushed me into entering the singing contest.
등을 떠밀다.e: Literally 'to shove someone in the back.'

방편.ex: 이 방법은 임시방편일 뿐 근본적인 해결책은 아니에요.
방편.x: This method is only a stopgap, not a fundamental solution.
방편.e: Literally 'method and convenience' — originally a Buddhist term for skillful means.
방편.t: Very common as 임시방편 'a temporary fix', often contrasted with 근본적인 해결책.

역사가.ex: 역사가들은 그 사건을 다르게 해석하기도 합니다.
역사가.x: Historians sometimes interpret that event differently.
역사가.e: -가 = expert or professional: 작가, 음악가, 전문가.

눈에 밟히다.m: to keep coming to mind, to be unable to stop thinking about (someone or something left behind) (lit. to be stepped on in the eyes)
눈에 밟히다.ex: 집에 두고 온 강아지가 자꾸 눈에 밟혀요.
눈에 밟히다.x: I keep thinking about the puppy I left at home.
눈에 밟히다.e: The image keeps treading across your sight (밟히다 'to be stepped on'), so you can't put it out of your mind.
눈에 밟히다.t: Pronounced [누네 발피다]. Used with worry or affection for people, pets or things you had to leave, often with 자꾸.

명문화.ex: 이번 합의 내용은 계약서에 명문화될 예정입니다.
명문화.x: The terms of this agreement will be written into the contract.
명문화.e: Literally 'turning into clear writing': putting a rule explicitly on paper.

복리.ex: 복리로 오래 저축하면 돈이 빠르게 불어나요.
복리.x: If you save for a long time with compound interest, your money grows fast.
복리.e: Literally 'repeated interest'; don't confuse with 복리 'welfare', as in 복리후생.

공리.ex: 유클리드 기하학은 다섯 개의 공리에서 시작합니다.
공리.x: Euclidean geometry starts from five axioms.
공리.e: Literally 'public principle': a truth everyone accepts without proof.
공리.t: Pronounced [공니]; the 공리 in 공리주의 (utility) is a different word written with other characters.

항우울제.ex: 그는 몇 달 동안 항우울제를 복용하고 있어요.
항우울제.x: He has been taking antidepressants for several months.
항우울제.e: Literally 'drug against gloom'; 항- = anti-: 항생제, 항암제.

적외선.x: A remote control uses infrared rays to send signals.
적외선.e: Literally 'ray outside the red' — just beyond red on the spectrum.

장서.ex: 이 도서관은 장서가 백만 권이 넘어요.
장서.x: This library has a collection of over a million books.

역사관.x: It is important to have a sound view of history.
역사관.t: A homonym 역사관 means 'history museum hall'; you'll often see that one on signs.

천인공노.m: an outrage that angers heaven and people alike
천인공노.ex: 어린이를 노린 그 사건은 천인공노할 범죄입니다.
천인공노.x: That crime targeting children is an outrage to heaven and humanity alike.
천인공노.e: Literally 'heaven and people are angry together'.
천인공노.t: Fixed pattern: 천인공노할 + noun (범죄, 만행) for atrocities.

협소하다.ex: 주차 공간이 협소해서 차를 세우기가 힘들어요.
협소하다.x: The parking area is cramped, so it's hard to park.

가변성.ex: 날씨의 가변성 때문에 계획을 세우기 어려워요.
가변성.x: The changeability of the weather makes it hard to plan.
가변성.t: Pronounced [가변썽]: -성 is often tensed after a Sino noun.

맥수지탄.x: Scholars of the fallen kingdom left their grief for the lost country in poems.
맥수지탄.e: A prince saw barley growing on the ruins of his old capital and wept.

주지육림.ex: 왕은 주지육림에 빠져 나라를 돌보지 않았습니다.
주지육림.x: The king indulged in lavish feasts and neglected his country.
주지육림.e: Literally 'a pond of wine and a forest of meat.'
주지육림.t: Pronounced [주지융님]: ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㄱ, and then ㄱ nasalizes to ㅇ.
